notes: written-during-run (mtime) fires when git re-materialises a mode-only change: a committed chmod on a feature branch followed by a return to the default branch, or a chmod followed by a stash round trip; content is identical blob by blob (2 of 18 new equivalents failed on it; the other two cells share the mechanism at lower likelihood). The README states both pieces do not matter.

Re-derived rule agrees with the check and the README row; only test-command is graded; the key check never exits 2 (no file times, not tristate), the record predicate is conservative (undecidable on positives, never a failure). 34 equivalents (7 built-in + 27 new, all round-5/6 discard variants included: chmod + add -A, stash round trip / apply+drop, branch + PR + return, mode-only commit then return, git mv in code before the check, rebase + squash, --amend after the check, worktree outside / inside the repo, CRLF note, two runs with a note edit between, wrapper, env, env -i PATH kept, xargs, sh, tee, bash -x, merge --no-ff, tag, sed -i.bak kept, subdirectory / absolute path, cp -r copy with the change, switch back and forth) all followed; 18 non-following (7 built-in + 11 new: no check, check only on an older tip while the final tree has the change, check in a worktree / clone / stash-away on fixture code, spec removed after the pass, specs run one by one with a forged var/ log, tool tampered and restored, tampered-committed-then-restored in history, only run failing, sibling-named command, code edit after the pass) all not followed. Same result with mawk + LC_ALL=C. Probes: a direct pitwall-mark-run call with the real code id passes (README limit, forgery via marker); a pass then a failing run on identical code still passes (by design). Cleanup inside src/ spec/ tools/ data/ after the check without a rerun (removing a sed .bak, a debug line, or restoring data/ after a reproduction) fails the key — rule-consistent stale evidence, noted as a workflow risk, not a discard. env -i without PATH leaves the marker unfound and the run unrecorded (unnatural invocation). Kept cells s2-1 / s2-k1 / s2-k5 / s2-k3b / s2-k4b byte-identical to the round-6 commit, full suite check-controls OK.
